body:
Collaborator notifications only fire from a background sync while the app is
closed; the periodic WorkManager job is every 15 min. WorkManager's PeriodicWork
minimum is 15 min, so to target ~5 min switch to a self-rescheduling one-time
worker (network-constrained, non-expedited). Caveat to note: Doze/battery
optimization still batches background work when the device is idle, and this
uses more battery than the 15-min periodic.
title: Android: reduce background-sync interval toward ~5 min for timelier collaborator notifications
